title: Agent and LLM trace store
requirement: Store and inspect traces of agent and LLM calls locally from OpenTelemetry data, with one tool unless a second adds a distinct, needed job.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Ingestion of both agents' OpenTelemetry output, query and inspection of a fixed set of traces, resource use, and overlap with experiment tracking.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
